summary: The root مَتَاعٌ (matāʿ) refers to anything useful or advantageous, like goods, household items, or provisions. It can also denote enjoyment or the necessities of life.
lane: مَتَاعٌ ذ Anything useful or advantageous; as goods: such as the utensils and furniture of a house or tent, or household-goods: any utensils, or apparatus: chattels: a commodity, and commodities; (Mgh, &c.;) generally best rendered goods, chattels, household-goods or chattels, or utensils and furniture. -b2- المَتَاعُ [signifies (tropical:) الفَرْجُ ;] a woman's pudendum: (TA:) [see مُتَوَهِّجَةٌ , in art. وهج : and] the penis. (Mgh.) -b3- مَتَاعٌ also applies to Food, the necessaries of life: see two exs. voce حَفَفٌ . -b4- مَتَاعٌ for a divorced wife, A provision of necessaries, such as food and clothing and household-utensils or furniture: see عَرْفٌ , and Bd in ii. 242: i. q. تَمْتِيعٌ . (Bd in ii. 237.) -b5- مَتَاعٌ i. q. مَا يُتَمَتَّعُ بِهِ , and الاِسْتِمْتَاعُ ; (Jel in iv. 79;) generally best rendered Enjoyment, in the Kur iv. 79 and ix. 38 and similar cases. See مُتْعَةٌ .

headwords.gloss: The day became advanced, the sun being high; before the declining of the sun from the meridian; made him to live

parts.t: The day became advanced, the sun being high,
before the declining of the sun from the meridian.
He gave her a gift after divorce.

headwords.def: مَتَعَ النَّهَارُ The day became advanced, the sun being high, (S, K,) before the declining of the sun from the meridian. (K.) . مَتَّعَهُ He (God) made him to live. (Bd in xi. 3.) See مَلّا . مَتَّعَهَا He gave her a gift after divorce. (K.) And مَتَّهَا بِكَذَا He gave her (a divorced wife) such a thing. (Msb.)

headwords.gloss: He benefited; profited by it; had the benefit, use; enjoyment, of it; he enjoyed it

parts.t: profited by it; had the benefit, use,
enjoyment, of it; he enjoyed it;
but this restriction is not always meant.] You say.
I enjoyed the drinking a morning-draught of wine
the listening to the songs of a girl
or utensils and furniture for the house, or tent.
(MA:) so in many cases in the Kur, &c.

headwords.def: تَمَتَّعَ بِهِ and and are syn., signifying اِنْتَفَعَ بِهِ زَمَانًا طَوِيلًا ; (Ham, p. 165 ;) [ He benefited, or profited by it; had the benefit, use, or enjoyment, of it; he enjoyed it; accord. to the above authority, for a long time; but this restriction is not always meant.] You say. اِسْتَمْتَعْتُ بِٱصْطِبَاحِ خَمْرٍ [ I enjoyed the drinking a morning-draught of wine ]: and بِالإِصْغَآءِ إِلَى أَغَانِى جَارِيَةٍ [ the listening to the songs of a girl ]. (Mo'allakát, p. 169.) تَمَتَّعَ He became provided with مَتَاع , or utensils and furniture for the house, or tent. (TA, voce تَبَتَّتَ , q. v.) تَمَتَّعَ i. q. عَاشَ . (Bd, Jel, xi. 68.) تَمَتَّعَ بِهِ generally signifies He enjoyed it: (MA:) so in many cases in the Kur, &c.

headwords.gloss: He benefited; profited by such a thing
headwords.def: اِسْتَمْتَعَ بِكَذَا , and , He benefited or profited by such a thing. (Msb.) See 5. مُسْتَمْتُعٌ : see مَلْبَسٌ .

headwords.def: مُتْعَةٌ Enjoyment; a subst. in the sense of تَمَتُّعٌ ; (S, Msb, K;) syn. نَعْمَةٌ . (Jel, xlvi. 26.) See an ex., in a verse of Lebeed, voce فَرْطٌ . مُتْعَةٌ A gift to a divorced wife. (Msb, K.) See مَتَاعٌ . متعة الضُّحَى [i. e. مُتْعَة ?] i. q. أَوَّلُهَا . (TA voce فِيقَة , in art. فوق .)
